candidate.user_input: How do I indicate my availability as a mentor on the GitLab team page?
candidate.reference: Indicate your mentorship availability on the GitLab team page by setting the `mentor` status to `true`. This will appear on the team page with a line that reads `Available as a mentor`.

evidence.quote: Indicate your mentorship availability on the GitLab team page by setting the `mentor` status to `true`. This will appear on the team page with a line that reads `Available as a mentor`.
evidence.contribution: Explains how to indicate mentorship availability on the team page.

candidate.connection: The context directly explains how to indicate mentorship availability on the team page by setting the mentor status to true.

source_conditions: You must set the `mentor` status to `true` on the GitLab team page to indicate mentorship availability.
When you set the `mentor` status to `true`, a line will appear on the team page that reads `Available as a mentor`.
